'''Brahtikka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who often worked as an insertion specialist for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. She worked with the [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] [[LE-LU979|Lelu]] and used the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Spinster's Loom]]''. She transported a team of operatives to the ''[[Shadow Raptor]]'' shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Behind the scenes==
Brahtikka appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] [[2014]] adventure ''[[Dead in the Water]]''.
